semantics.positive: An explicit keep_whole reason on a saved kept proposal confirms retaining the entire current recording.
semantics.negative: A nonempty saved recording review with every proposal skipped rejects the entire current recording.
semantics.unknown: Every other recording, including95-100percent coverage of kept edited clips; the user confirmed near-full coverage means only the edited clips.
semantics.permanent_storage_worth: Unknown; no future expiry/replacement label is created.
semantics.legacy_coverage_proxy: Invalidated. Coverage>=.95 is not a whole positive, and a mixed recording below any coverage threshold is not a whole negative.

history: Keep all historical coverage-proxy artifacts; new policy-specific receipt only; old proxy training path invalidated before fit
correction: Reject unsupported surviving saved label types before all-skipped whole inference; triage skip plus nontriage keep cannot become negative
